# PriceDawn

> PriceDawn checks your competitors' Shopify product prices every day and emails you what changed each morning at 7:00 in your time zone.

## Price
- One plan: $4/month for up to 500 links, cancel anytime

## Pages
- Home: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com
- Pricing: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/pricing
- PriceDawn compared with Prisync and PriceMole: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/prisync-alternative
- How to track Shopify competitor prices: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/track-shopify-competitor-prices
- Terms of service: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/terms
- Privacy policy: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/privacy
- Refund policy: https://pricedawn.spacesonlabs.com/refunds

## Notes
- A link is one product variant.
- Shopify stores only.
- A price is shown as the plain number from the store's product data; a link is only compared with itself.
- The plan includes the CSV export of the full price history.
